name: Delayed Union of Fracture
definition: Fracture healing that is slower than expected for the specific bone, pattern, biology and treatment context but still shows potential for union.

investigations.principle: Serial radiographs are central; CT, inflammatory markers and metabolic evaluation are used selectively.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Optimize stability, nutrition, smoking cessation and metabolic factors
amber: Surgical revision/bone stimulation depends on biology, stability and time course.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna sandhana principles may complement modern healing assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture healing that is slower than expected for the specific bone, pattern, biology and treatment context but still shows potential for union.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
